subtitulo: Discover the ideal therapeutic support for your wellbeing in 7 quick steps
cargandoSub: Lic. Sofía Reynaga is analyzing your responses with empathy and confidentiality...
btnWhatsApp: Book Consultation with this Profile on WhatsApp

p1.titulo: 1. What challenge or topic would you like to address today?
p1.sub: Select the option that best reflects how you feel right now:

opciones.titulo: Anxiety, Stress and Overthinking
opciones.desc: Constant tension, panic sensations or a racing mind
opciones.empathy: We validate what you are feeling. An overwhelmed mind is not weakness; it has clear causes and proven scientific tools to restore calm.

opciones.titulo: Couples and Family Therapy
opciones.desc: Communication breakdowns, crises, jealousy or distance
opciones.empathy: Acknowledging relationship struggles is the most mature step toward healing communication and rebuilding mutual trust.

opciones.titulo: Sadness, Grief or Emotional Relief
opciones.desc: Discouragement, feeling alone or simply needing to be heard
opciones.empathy: Your feelings are valid and deserve to be heard in a safe, warm and judgment-free environment.

opciones.titulo: Personal Direction and Self-Esteem
opciones.desc: Decision making, clarifying life goals or self-discovery
opciones.empathy: Seeking mental clarity is an act of self-care and commitment to your personal growth and peace of mind.

ansiedad.titulo: 2. Which of these sensations do you experience most often?
ansiedad.sub: Choose the one that best describes your experience:

opciones.titulo: Looping thoughts and constant worrying
opciones.desc: Always anticipating worst-case scenarios
opciones.empathy: Having your mind on high alert is exhausting. CBT helps deactivate these cognitive loops.

opciones.titulo: Heart palpitations, chest tightness or muscle tension
opciones.desc: Intense physical sensations of shortness of breath or alertness
opciones.empathy: Your body is somatizing overload. We will teach you psychophysiological regulation.

opciones.titulo: Sudden fear spikes or panic attacks
opciones.desc: Feeling like you are losing control or in imminent danger
opciones.empathy: Panic is scary, but not harmful in itself. We will teach you grounding skills from session one.

opciones.titulo: Insomnia and severe difficulty resting
opciones.desc: Waking up with anxiety or struggling to fall asleep
opciones.empathy: Restoring restful sleep will be one of our very first clinical priorities.

pareja.titulo: 2. How would you describe the current dynamic in the relationship?
pareja.sub: Select the pattern that best represents the challenge:

opciones.titulo: Frequent arguments that escalate quickly
opciones.desc: Any daily topic turns into disagreement or blame
opciones.empathy: Breaking the reactive conflict cycle is the core goal of systemic couples therapy.

opciones.titulo: Emotional disconnection and prolonged silence
opciones.desc: Feeling like strangers or mere roommates
opciones.empathy: Distance is often a shield against hurt. Rebuilding the bridge of intimacy is possible.

opciones.titulo: Trust crisis, infidelity or intense jealousy
opciones.desc: Persistent insecurity following broken agreements
opciones.empathy: Healing a wound of trust requires patience and structured clinical guidance.

opciones.titulo: Doubts about staying together or separating peacefully
opciones.desc: Uncertainty about the future of the bond or children
opciones.empathy: We will help both of you find clarity with maturity, respect and empathy.

apoyo.titulo: 2. How has your mood been manifesting recently?
apoyo.sub: Allow yourself to express what you are experiencing:

opciones.titulo: Feeling tearful or discouraged without an obvious reason
opciones.desc: Feeling like daily energy is completely depleted
opciones.empathy: Crying is how the body releases emotional pressure. You don't have to pretend everything is fine.

opciones.titulo: Feeling empty or emotionally numb
opciones.desc: Things that once brought joy no longer spark interest
opciones.empathy: This is a common sign of emotional exhaustion. Step by step, we will reconnect with your vitality.

opciones.titulo: Grief process, bereavement or painful breakup
opciones.desc: Pain from an absence that feels heavy to process alone
opciones.empathy: Grief needs to be navigated with tenderness and professional support.

opciones.titulo: Feeling misunderstood and profoundly lonely
opciones.desc: Feeling like you have no one to truly open up to
opciones.empathy: You are not alone here. Lic. Sofía Reynaga provides an empathetic, active listening space.

general.titulo: 2. What is your primary goal when starting therapy?
general.sub: What positive shift would you like to achieve:

opciones.titulo: Making an important life or career decision with certainty
opciones.desc: Overcoming indecision and finding your compass
opciones.empathy: Sorting through values, priorities and fears will give you the confidence you need.

opciones.titulo: Strengthening self-esteem and setting healthy boundaries
opciones.desc: Stop people-pleasing at the expense of your own wellbeing
opciones.empathy: Learning to say 'no' without guilt is one of psychotherapy's greatest gifts.

opciones.titulo: Managing frustration, irritability or anger
opciones.desc: Better regulating emotional impulses in tense moments
opciones.empathy: Emotional intelligence is strengthened through practical cognitive techniques.

opciones.titulo: Self-awareness and preventive mental health
opciones.desc: Investing in my mental wellness before difficulties escalate
opciones.empathy: Prevention is the wisest way to care for your overall health.

p3.titulo: 3. How long have you been experiencing this situation?
p3.sub: Helps us assess the duration of your distress:

opciones.titulo: Less than 1 month (recent or acute event)
opciones.desc: Triggered by a recent change, conflict or news
opciones.empathy: Addressing this early prevents it from consolidating into a chronic pattern.

opciones.titulo: Between 1 and 6 months
opciones.desc: It has been recurring consistently over the past several weeks
opciones.empathy: Your mind and body are signaling that you need professional support.

opciones.titulo: More than 6 months or several years
opciones.desc: I feel I have been carrying this on my own for a long time
opciones.empathy: Carrying this for so long is heavy, but it is never too late to reconfigure your wellbeing.

p4.titulo: 4. In what area of your life do you notice the greatest impact?
p4.sub: Where do you feel this takes the highest toll:

opciones.titulo: In my sleep, physical health and daily energy
opciones.desc: Fatigue, body tension, headaches or low stamina
opciones.empathy: Taking care of your body begins with attending to what is happening in your mind.

opciones.titulo: In my work performance, studies or focus
opciones.desc: Procrastination, brain fog or productivity drop
opciones.empathy: Regaining focus is fully achievable once we reduce your underlying stress.

opciones.titulo: In my relationships with loved ones or partner
opciones.desc: Irritability, withdrawing or frequent misunderstandings
opciones.empathy: When you heal within, the quality of your relationships naturally improves.

opciones.titulo: In my inner tranquility and daily peace of mind
opciones.desc: Struggling to relax even during downtime
opciones.empathy: Restoring inner peace is at the very core of psychological therapy.

p5.titulo: 5. Have you had psychological therapy before?
p5.sub: To tailor explanations to your previous experience:

opciones.titulo: This is my first time seeking professional support
opciones.desc: I feel curious or slightly nervous about how it works
opciones.empathy: Congratulations on taking this step! We will guide you with warmth and complete clarity.

opciones.titulo: Yes, I have had therapy before and want to resume
opciones.desc: I am familiar with the process and want to address this topic
opciones.empathy: Great foundation. We will build upon your past insights to move forward effectively.

opciones.titulo: I have tried managing it on my own with books or videos
opciones.desc: I feel I need expert guidance tailored to my situation
opciones.empathy: Self-help is valuable, but personalized clinical accompaniment makes all the difference.

p6.titulo: 6. What modality best suits your comfort and schedule?
p6.sub: Both formats share identical clinical rigor and confidentiality:

opciones.titulo: 💻 100% Online Session (Meet / Zoom)
opciones.desc: From your home or office, anywhere in Peru or internationally
opciones.empathy: Ideal for saving commute time and speaking from your most private space.

opciones.titulo: 📞 Phone Call or WhatsApp Audio
opciones.desc: For quick agility or if you prefer audio-only communication
opciones.empathy: Perfect for immediate emotional containment and focused guidance.

opciones.titulo: 📍 In-person (Villa El Salvador Office)
opciones.desc: Av. Revolución 1840, South Lima (By appointment)
opciones.empathy: We welcome you in our clinical office with total warmth and confidentiality.

p7.titulo: 7. What time of day is most convenient for your consultation?
p7.sub: Please also share your name to personalize your guidance report:
p7.placeholderNombre: E.g. Ana Morales (or whatever you prefer to be called)
p7.empathy: Excellent. We are compiling your clinical analysis to provide accurate, personalized orientation.
